output.summary: The 98% figure uses revised promised dates. Brightwell's receiving log shows 81% on or before the booked date, down from 87%, against a 98.4% scorecard. Of 311 revisions, the customer requested only 46. The bonus plan changed no revision or reason-code rules. Lateness complaints rose 35% while damage and billing complaints stayed flat, which contradicts the portal-artifact explanation. Weather disruption days fell. Real timeliness has likely deteriorated and the metric is being gamed. The campaign and the higher bonus tier would be harmful. Suspend external use of the figure and audit revisions. Re-base the incentive on the original date. Driver-shortage and RouteWise effects remain unestablished, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
